author: Anju Agnihotri Chaba
title: Farmers’ column: A ‘purple’ revolution: 27-yr-old reaping rewards of a new and unusual seed potato variety
description: According to the farmer, the production of purple potatoes can lead to earnings anywhere between Rs 6 to 20 lakh per acre depending upon the quality and marketing.
content: Punjab, particularly its Doaba region, has long been known as a major hub for seed potatoes, traditionally producing several varieties that are mostly brown on the outside and white or yellow inside.… [+7556 chars]
